title: New Firefighting Technologies Could Help Battle Blazes Like Those in France and Spain
summary: Spain declared a national emergency in the community of Madrid and the province of Ávila due to the spread of intense wildfires . Google Maps features a layer capable of triggering emergency alerts and displaying the perimeters of wildfires in Spain.
